subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should this focused workspace breadcrumb be ported to the current Control UI header, or should active-agent/workspace certainty move to the no-breadcrumb direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101017?
rationale: The patch is coherent and proven, but current main has moved the UI surface and an open maintainer draft deletes the breadcrumb component, so automation cannot choose the user-visible header contract.

options.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Rebase/port the workspace indicator onto the current header/app-host files, fix checks, and treat broader switcher/toast/prefix ideas as follow-up work.

options.title: Adopt No-Breadcrumb Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR and require the persistent multi-agent/workspace context to be designed into the replacement surface instead.

options.title: Broaden Before Merge
options.body: Require the PR to cover stronger live-target proof or more of the linked issue's optional UX before it can close the issue.

recommendation.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Rebase/port the workspace indicator onto the current header/app-host files, fix checks, and treat broader switcher/toast/prefix ideas as follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: Their open maintainer-labeled PR is the concrete competing header-direction proposal that maintainers need to reconcile with this focused breadcrumb.
